title: The Necessary Silence
author: Cyrus Delacroix
blurb: Silas Quintana, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
